modmenu.descriptionTranslation.hiteffect: Customizes hit-related visual effects: the hurt flash color, flashing armor, items and arms, and hit particles.
options.hiteffect.title: hiteffect Settings
options.hiteffect.mode.disabled.descript: Every effect is off and everything looks vanilla.
options.hiteffect.mode.oneconfig.descrip: The settings are managed in OneConfig. The settings below show what OneConfig applies and cannot be changed here.
options.hiteffect.mode.oneconfig.missing: OneConfig mode is selected, but OneConfig is not installed, so the settings below apply.
options.hiteffect.flash.armor.descriptio: Armor flashes together with the hurt mob or player.
options.hiteffect.flash.elytra.descripti: Elytra flash together with the hurt mob or player.
options.hiteffect.flash.horse_armor.desc: Horse armor flashes together with the hurt horse.
options.hiteffect.flash.wolf_armor.descr: Wolf armor, including its cracks, flashes together with the hurt wolf.
options.hiteffect.flash.saddles.descript: Saddles flash together with the hurt mob.
Llama carpets, happy ghast harnesses and nautilus armor flash together with the hurt mob.
options.hiteffect.flash.held_items.descr: Items held in the hands flash together with the hurt mob or player.
options.hiteffect.flash.head_items.descr: Carved pumpkins, skulls and blocks worn on the head flash together with the hurt mob or player.
options.hiteffect.flash.villager_items.d: Items held by villagers and wandering traders flash together with them.
options.hiteffect.flash.fox_items.descri: Items in a fox's mouth flash together with the hurt fox.
options.hiteffect.flash.panda_items.desc: Items held by a panda flash together with the hurt panda.
options.hiteffect.flash.dolphin_items.de: Items carried by a dolphin flash together with the hurt dolphin.
Blocks carried by an enderman flash together with the hurt enderman.
options.hiteffect.flash.first_person_arm: Your arm, including the sleeve, flashes in first person while you are hurt.
options.hiteffect.hurt_color.description: The color hurt entities flash in.
options.hiteffect.hurt_color.presets.des: Click a color to use it. The first one is vanilla red.
options.hiteffect.rainbow.description: The hurt color cycles through all hues.
options.hiteffect.hurt_strength.descript: How strongly the hurt color tints the entity. Vanilla is 30%.
options.hiteffect.sharpness_particles.de: Sharpness particles appear the moment you hit a mob or player, whatever you hold.
options.hiteffect.crit_particles.descrip: Critical hit particles appear the moment you hit a mob or player, even when the hit is not critical.
